sqls:
SELECT order_year,
       SUM(net_revenue_cents) AS net_revenue_cents,
       SUM(gross_profit_cents) AS gross_profit_cents,
       SUM(gross_profit_cents) * 1.0 / SUM(net_revenue_cents) AS gross_margin_rate
FROM order_performance
WHERE order_year IN (2024, 2025)
GROUP BY order_year
ORDER BY order_year

extra.answer: 按订单归属年口径（order_performance 表）：2024 年净营收 3,185.73 万元、毛利 795.69 万元、毛利率 24.98%；2025 年净营收 3,793.27 万元、毛利 970.47 万元、毛利率 25.58%。经营规模方面，2025 年净营收同比增长约 19.1%，规模明显扩大；盈利能力方面，毛利额同比增长约 22.0%，且毛利率提升约 0.61 个百分点，说明盈利增长快于收入增长，单位收入的赚钱能力也在改善，整体呈量价齐升、盈利质量向好的态势。

sqls:
SELECT order_year,
       SUM(net_revenue_cents) AS net_revenue_cents,
       SUM(gross_profit_cents) AS gross_profit_cents,
       CAST(SUM(gross_profit_cents) AS REAL) / NULLIF(SUM(net_revenue_cents), 0) AS gross_margin_rate
FROM order_performance
WHERE order_year IN (2024, 2025)
GROUP BY order_year
ORDER BY order_year;
